target_customer: Individuals and enterprises using ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini who must not leak sensitive data, including regulated teams
problem: Employees paste private data into AI tools; redaction before the prompt leaves the device prevents leaks.
business_model: Browser extension with free trial and enterprise tier
product_category: AI data loss prevention browser extension

founders.name: Sukrut Oak
founders.background_notes: 3+ years of AI safety and benchmarking research per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: On device PII detection and prompt rewriting across several chat UIs; moderate engineering, browser extension fragility.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar redaction extensions exist and chat vendors can add native controls.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found as of 2026-11; many competing extensions appeared in 2026.

market_need_then: Enterprises worried about leaking data into AI tools in 2025; evidence is the company's HIPAA and privacy positioning, no spend data found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short privacy focused lines such as Your data. Your device. Your control.

brand_strength.rationale: Logos plus Guard is evocative of protection but little brand evidence found.

outcome_analysis: LogosGuard is an early stage active company with two Stanford trained founders with Apple backgrounds. No funding amount, press or outcome is public, and the product faces many look alike extensions and platform native controls, so no conclusion about success can be drawn yet.
notes: Funding search found no amount for LogosGuard. Competitor search returned only 2026 dated tools (for example Prompt Armour, 2026-03), which are after founding, so the list is empty. Outcome search found nothing about the company.
